subject: Last tip: outline before you draft
preview: Closing this thread — method + link if you want it.
body: If a paper is coming up, remember the method: research question → outline → easiest section first. Research Generator is one free way to run that path.
If not — all good. Mute or unsubscribe anytime. No hard feelings.
P.S. Bookmark it for the next deadline. Future-you will thank present-you.
